items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Bunchy Fox, who has a little program and we did a couple of concerts.

ctx.x: That was nice. Well, he's very thoughtful anyway.

I think I talked to him once on the phone. But there's a gal in the neighborhood, Bunchy Fox, who has a little program and we did a couple of concerts. We did one in Katona Park, right near the administration building there.
